**Part A: Importing and Inspecting a CSV**

**A1**
```{r}
library(readr)
emp_df <- read.csv("employees.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(emp_df)

```
**A2**
```{r}
str(head(df, 5))
summary(emp_df)
```
**A3**
```{r}
nrow(emp_df)
ncol(emp_df)
sapply(emp_df, class)
```

**A4**
```{r}
mean(emp_df$salary)
max(emp_df$age)
table(emp_df$department)
```

**Part B: Creating Data Frames**

**B1**
```{r}
new_hires <- data.frame (
  emp_id = c(21, 22, 23),
  name = c("Uma", "Victor","Wen"),
  department = c("HR", "IT", "sales"),
  sex = c("F", "M", "F"),
  age = c(28, 37, 33),
  salary = c(45000, 83000, 60000),
  years_service = c(2, 9, 6),
  rating = c(3,4,5),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
new_hires
```
**B2**
```{r}
emp_all <- rbind(emp_df, new_hires)
dim(emp_all)
```

**B3**
```{r}
emp_all$bonus <- round(emp_all$salary * 0.05)
emp_all$bonus
```

**Part C: Subsetting**

**C1**
```{r}
emp_all[1:5, c("name", "salary")]
```
**C2**
```{r}
emp_all[emp_all$salary > 70000, ]
```

**C3**
```{r}
subset(emp_all, department == "IT" & years_service >= 5, select = c(name, years_service, salary))
```
**C4**
```{r}
older_rows <- which(emp_all$age > 50)
print(older_rows)
print(emp_all$name[older_rows])
```

**C5**
```{r}
head(emp_all[, !(names(emp_all) %in% c("emp_id", "bonus"))], 3)
```

**C6**
```{r}
head(emp_all[, !(names(emp_all) %in% c("emp_id", "bonus"))], 3)
```

**Part D: Factors**

**D1**
```{r}
emp_all$department <- factor(emp_all$department)
emp_all$sex <- factor(emp_all$sex)
levels(emp_all$department)
levels(emp_all$sex)

```

**D2**
```{r}
table(emp_all$department)
table(emp_all$department, emp_all$sex)

```

**D3**
```{r}
emp_all$rating_level <- factor(emp_all$rating, 
                               levels = 1:5, 
                               labels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very Good", "Excellent"), 
                               ordered = TRUE)
table(emp_all$rating_level)

```

**D4**
```{r}
for (dept in levels(emp_all$department)) {
  mean_sal <- mean(emp_all$salary[emp_all$department == dept])
  cat("Department:", dept, "- Mean Salary:", round(mean_sal), "\n")
}

```

**Part E: Conditional Statements**

**E1**
```{r}
emp_all$salary_band <- 
  ifelse(emp_all$salary >= 70000, "High", 
  ifelse(emp_all$salary >= 50000, "Medium", "Low"))
table(emp_all$salary_band)
```

**E2**
```{r}
emp_all$level <- ifelse(emp_all$years_service >= 8, "Senior", "Junior")
table(emp_all$level)
```

**E3**
```{r}
raise_pct <- function(rating){
  if(rating == 5){
    return(0.10)
  } else if(rating == 4){
    return(0.07)
  } else if (rating == 3){
      return(0.04)
  }else{
      return(0.05)
    }
}
emp_all$raise <- sapply(emp_all$rating, raise_pct)
emp_all$new_salary <- round(emp_all$salary * (1 + emp_all$raise))
head(emp_all[, c("name", "rating", "raise", "new_salary")], 5)
```

**E4**
```{r}
total <- sum(emp_all$new_salary)
if (total < 1600000) {
  print("Budget OK")
} else {
  print("Over budget")
}
print(total)

```


**Part F: Sorting**

**F1**
```{r}
sort(emp_all$salary, decreasing = TRUE)[1:5]
sort(emp_all$name)[1:5]

```

**F2**
```{r}
sorted_indices <- order(emp_all$salary, decreasing = TRUE)
by_salary <- emp_all[sorted_indices, c("name", "department", "salary")]
head(by_salary, 5)
```
